name: subagent-wall
description: A wall-clock limit for subagents (a warning, then only git, gh and .md/.txt writes) and a nudge for a code-changing subagent past a set context size that has edited nothing

warnMinutes.title: Warn a subagent at (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: Tells the subagent to finish up. 0 turns the warning off.

limitMinutes.title: Limit a subagent at (minutes)
limitMinutes.description: From here the subagent may only run git and gh and write .md or .txt files. 0 turns the limit off.

noEditNudgeK.title: Nudge a subagent with no edits at (thousand tokens of context)
noEditNudgeK.description: A code-changing subagent that reaches this much context without editing a file is told to stop exploring. 0 turns the nudge off.

codeAgentTypes.title: Code-changing agent types (comma separated)
codeAgentTypes.description: Only subagents of these types get the no-edit nudge. Use the subagent type names you dispatch work with.
